Preview equals decoded contents.detail: buildExportPreview measures the final sealed projection, not request/UI state. The test decodes the exported .inkflip.json through the T24 import gate and asserts the preview's counts (findings, occurrences, produced/retained denominators, checks, readers, pages, regions, transforms, crops, annotations), decoded/encoded asset bytes and exact canonical JSON byte length against the decoded object. Preview-only fields (limits, warnings) are derived from that same object.

raw text/geometry/coverage survive.detail: Retained occurrences keep raw_text byte-exact plus normalized_text/normalization_map; geometry keeps precision, polygon, basis and transform_ids and every referenced transform is carried; check results keep original produced_occurrence_count while retained_occurrence_ids prunes to the kept set; plan.selected_pages, document.page_count, plan.checks/budgets and reader name/version/build/adapter/settings/model_hashes/limitations persist. The projection is re-sealed and re-validated before return.

no source PDF without explicit opt-in.detail: Default projection carries no source_pdf asset and nulls document.source_asset_id ('Original PDF excluded.' in export.omissions). Opt-in Uint8Array bytes are hash/length-bound to document.sha256/byte_length before inclusion — mismatch fails SOURCE; 'carry' reuses only an already-embedded asset whose payload verifies. Filename and notes are likewise off by default and opt-in only. HTML embeds no source bytes (image/png only).

script-like strings escaped.detail: Hostile payloads (<script>, event handlers, javascript: URLs, quotes/tags) rotated through finding title/explanation, occurrence raw_text and reader names stay inert strings in JSON and appear only escaped in HTML. renderReportHtml escapes every report-controlled string (NUL replaced for display; JSON keeps raw bytes), embeds only sanitizePng re-encodes — verified byte-unequal to a stored payload with a hostile tEXt chunk — and passes assertScriptFreeHtml on the final document before return.

missing bytes marked evidence-only.detail: Asset payloads failing base64/byte_length/sha256 audit are dropped, recorded in notices.missingAssetIds and export.omissions, and mode can never upgrade to replayable. An explicit source request with absent/unverifiable bytes sets requestedSourceMissing, records 'Requested original bytes unavailable — evidence only.' and continues as evidence rather than fabricating replayability. Occurrences whose raster reference vanishes keep their reading with source_asset_id nulled and disclosed — missing evidence stays missing.

export is deterministic aside from exclu.detail: Identical inputs produce byte-identical canonical JSON and HTML (test asserts string equality on repeated exports). Runs differing only in execution.execution_id/started_at/duration_ms and report_id share reportDigest — those are exactly the fields the canonical digest excludes, so they are the only permitted delta. serializeReportJson re-emits every schema member in declared order, so input insertion order cannot affect bytes. exportFileName derives from mode + report_id prefix only, never user data.
